description: Defines the egl_cache_t class for managing EGL cache, including singleton access, cache modes, blob storage, and file-based persistence within the Android graphics system.

classes.name: egl_cache_t
classes.description: Manages EGL cache with singleton pattern, supporting blob storage, cache modes, and file persistence.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the cache for a given display.

methods.name: setBlob
methods.description: Inserts a key/value blob into the cache.

methods.name: getBlob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob from the cache based on key.

methods.name: getCacheSize
methods.description: Returns total cache size in bytes.
